name: just-works
description: Vitalii Babenko's Claude Code configuration. Hosts the reliability harness as a plugin so its hooks and scripts stay colocated and reachable by a stable installed path, rather than through whichever project happens to be open.

plugins.name: reliability
plugins.description: Fail-closed reliability guards: universal destructive-action and self-protection rules in every project, optional repository policy for reviewed-script pinning and protected paths, and verified contract delivery to subagents. Guards that cannot run are refusals, and repository policy can only add restrictions.
